scenes.title: The Album
scenes.headline: UK breakthrough
scenes.supportingCopy: The song appears on the album "The Best Of Blondie" (1981). Originally from the band's self-titled debut album, Blondie, the song was Blondie's second and final single on the Private Stock label. The Best of Blondie (released in Germany and the Netherlands as Blondie's Hits) is the first greatest hits album by American rock band Blondie. The album peaked at number four in the United Kingdom and number 30 in the United States, while becoming the band's only number-one album in Australia. Artist: Blondie · Title: In The Flesh · Album: In The Flesh · Year: 1976 · Genre: Rock · Path: MEDIA/VIDEO/1970's/Blondie - In The Although the band's first two albums, Blondie (1976) and Plastic Letters (1978), were successful in the UK and Australia, Blondie was regarded as an underground band in the US until the release of their critically acclaimed third album Parallel Lines (1978).
